def task(run, chunk_id=None):
    run, record, plan, chunks = open_run(run)
    answers, _ = submissions(run, record, plan, chunks)
    selected = [c for c in chunks if c["id"] == chunk_id] if chunk_id else [c for c in chunks if c["id"] not in answers]
    if chunk_id:
        require(selected, "unknown chunk")
    return task_identity(run, record, plan, selected[0]) if selected else {"status": "ready_to_build"}


def submit(run, chunk_id, answer_path, author):
    run, record, plan, chunks = open_run(run)
    require(isinstance(author, str) and author.strip(), "author label is required")
    selected = [c for c in chunks if c["id"] == chunk_id]
    require(len(selected) == 1, "unknown chunk")
    answer = gen._decode(regular(answer_path))
    gen.author_check(answer, selected[0])
    answers, provenance = submissions(run, record, plan, chunks)
    if chunk_id in answers:
        prior = next(p for p in provenance if p["chunk"] == chunk_id)
        require(answer == answers[chunk_id] and prior["author"] == author, "submission exists; preserve it and use a fresh run for changed interpretation")
        return {"status": "already_submitted", "chunk": chunk_id, "answer_sha256": gen.digest(answer)}
    receipt = {"profile": "a_c.project-submission/1", "chunk": chunk_id, "author": author,
               "project_sha256": gen.sha(regular(run / "PROJECT.json")),
               "task_sha256": task_identity(run, record, plan, selected[0])["task_sha256"],
               "answer_sha256": gen.digest(answer), "answer": answer}


def result_readback(run, record, plan, chunks, answers, provenance):
    result = gen._decode(regular(run / "BUILD.json"))
    require(result["profile"] == "a_c.project-build-result/1"
            and result["project_sha256"] == gen.sha(regular(run / "PROJECT.json")), "build receipt binding changed")
    require(result["submissions_sha256"] == gen.digest(provenance), "build no longer matches authored submissions")
    folder = run / "generation/proposal"
    require(set(result["files"]) == {p.relative_to(run).as_posix() for p in folder.rglob("*") if p.is_file()},
            "built artifact inventory changed")
    for relative, pin in result["files"].items():
        path = contained(run, relative)
        require(gen.sha(regular(path)) == pin, "built artifact changed: " + relative)
    require(result["subject_id"] == record["subject_id"], "built subject changed")
    require(result["method"] == record["method"]
            and result["source_manifest_sha256"] == record["manifest_sha256"], "build source or method identity differs")
    proposal = gen.load(folder / "result.json")
    require(result["mode"] == plan["mode"] and result["upstream_trial"] == proposal["upstream_trial"],
            "build acquisition mode or upstream result differs")
    require(result["formal_gate"] == proposal.get("formal_gate", {"status": "not_performed"}),
            "build formal result contradicts actual proposal result")
    validate_gate(plan, folder, result["formal_gate"])
    expected, _ = gen.model_from_answers(plan, chunks, answers, provenance)
    require(gen.load(folder / "model.json") == expected, "built model no longer corresponds to current inputs")
    model = ac_graph.validate(expected)
    require(result["model"] == {"id": expected["id"], "sha256": model.sha256}, "build model identity differs")
    require(ac_graph.decode(ac_graph.GraphCarrier(gen.load(folder / "carrier.json"))).document == expected,
            "built carrier differs from model")
    require(result["artifacts"] == {key: str(folder / name) for key, name in
            {"model": "model.json", "carrier": "carrier.json", "coverage": "coverage.json", "explorer": "explorer.html"}.items()},
            "artifact locations differ")
    return result


def status(run):
    run, record, plan, chunks = open_run(run)
    answers, provenance = submissions(run, record, plan, chunks)
    pending = [c["id"] for c in chunks if c["id"] not in answers]
    result = {"status": "authoring_required" if pending else "ready_to_build", "run": str(run),
              "subject_id": record["subject_id"], "method": record["method"], "pending": pending}
    if (run / "BUILD.json").exists():
        require(not pending, "completed build has missing submissions")
        result.update(status="built", result=result_readback(run, record, plan, chunks, answers, provenance))
    return result


def build(run):
    run, record, plan, chunks = open_run(run, verify_method=True)
    answers, provenance = submissions(run, record, plan, chunks)
    require(len(answers) == len(chunks), "missing authored chunks; request the next task")
    if (run / "BUILD.json").exists():
        result = result_readback(run, record, plan, chunks, answers, provenance)
        if plan.get("formal_checker"):
            # Replay through the existing checker rather than trusting a stored
            # success label. Recheck output is separate from immutable artifacts.
            root = run / "rechecks"
            require(not root.is_symlink(), "redirected recheck directory")
            root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
            index = len(list(root.iterdir())) + 1
            for ordinal, retained in enumerate(result["formal_gate"]["runs"]):
                checked = ac_formal_gate.recheck(plan["formal_checker"], retained, root / f"{index}-{ordinal}")
                require(checked["result"]["status"] == "verified", "required retained formal proof did not verify")
        return {**result, "status": "reused"}
    proposal = gen.emit_proposal(run / "generation", plan, chunks, answers, provenance,
                                 formal_checker=plan.get("formal_checker"))
    require(not gen.formal_exit(proposal), "required formal check did not verify; preserve partial output and gate evidence")
    folder = run / "generation/proposal"
    validate_gate(plan, folder, proposal.get("formal_gate", {"status": "not_performed"}))
    model = gen.load(folder / "model.json")
    view = ac_explore.render(ac_explore.view_data(model, run / "generation/corpus", heading=record["title"]))
    with (folder / "explorer.html").open("x", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        handle.write(view)
    result = {"profile": "a_c.project-build-result/1", "status": "built",
              "project_sha256": gen.sha(regular(run / "PROJECT.json")),
              "submissions_sha256": gen.digest(provenance),
              "subject_id": record["subject_id"], "method": record["method"],
              "mode": plan["mode"], "upstream_trial": proposal["upstream_trial"],
              "source_manifest_sha256": record["manifest_sha256"],
              "model": {"id": proposal["model_id"], "sha256": proposal["model_sha256"]},
              "artifacts": {key: str(folder / name) for key, name in
                            {"model": "model.json", "carrier": "carrier.json", "coverage": "coverage.json", "explorer": "explorer.html"}.items()},
              "files": {p.relative_to(run).as_posix(): gen.sha(regular(p)) for p in sorted(folder.rglob("*")) if p.is_file()},
              "formal_gate": proposal.get("formal_gate", {"status": "not_performed"}),
              "claim": "Source-grounded proposal and checked carrier; source fidelity, semantic completeness and acceptance remain unassessed."}
    gen.save(run / "BUILD.json", result, exclusive=True)
    return result


def author_check(answer: dict[str, Any], chunk: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    errors = schema_errors(answer, load(ASSETS / "author.schema.json"))
    require(not errors, "author schema: " + "; ".join(errors[:10]))
    segment_map = {segment["id"]: segment for segment in chunk["segments"]}
    records = [record for family in ("concepts", "relations", "constraints", "latitude", "residuals") for record in answer[family]]
    keys = [record["key"] for record in records]
    require(len(keys) == len(set(keys)), "author record keys are not unique within chunk")
    concept_keys = {record["key"] for record in answer["concepts"]}
    for record in records:
        record_path = "record[" + record["key"] + "]"
        require(bool(record["grounding"]), record_path + ": every authored record requires exact source grounding")
        for ordinal, ground in enumerate(record["grounding"]):
            ground_path = record_path + "/grounding/" + str(ordinal)
            require(ground["section_id"] in segment_map, ground_path + ": grounding names source outside chunk")
            segment = segment_map[ground["section_id"]]
            first, last = ground["start_line"], ground["end_line"]
            require(segment["start_line"] <= first <= last <= segment["end_line"], ground_path + ": grounding line range escapes supplied section")
            lines = segment["text"].splitlines(keepends=True)
            excerpt = "".join(lines[first - segment["start_line"]:last - segment["start_line"] + 1])
            require(bool(ground["quote"].strip()) and ground["quote"] in excerpt, ground_path + ": grounding quote is not exact source at declared range")
    for relation in answer["relations"]:
        require(relation["source_key"] in concept_keys and relation["target_key"] in concept_keys, "relation endpoints must be declared local concepts")
    for record in answer["constraints"] + answer["latitude"]:
        require(set(record["applies_to_keys"]) <= concept_keys and record["applies_to_keys"], "attachment targets must be declared local concepts")
    for record in answer["residuals"]:
        require(record["subject_key"] in set(keys) - {record["key"]}, "residual subject must be another local declared record")
        require(record["subject_key"] not in {r["key"] for r in answer["residuals"]}, "residual subjects must be concepts/relations/constraints/latitude")
    dispositions = answer["dispositions"]
    require(len(dispositions) == len(segment_map) and {d["section_id"] for d in dispositions} == set(segment_map), "section dispositions do not cover exact supplied sections")
    selected: set[str] = set()
    residual_keys = {record["key"] for record in answer["residuals"]}
    for disposition in dispositions:
        chosen = disposition["keys"]
        require(len(chosen) == len(set(chosen)) and set(chosen) <= set(keys), "disposition has duplicate/unknown record key")
        require(disposition["decision"] not in ("retained", "residual") or bool(chosen), "retained/residual section requires authored records")
        require(disposition["decision"] != "residual" or bool(set(chosen) & residual_keys), "residual disposition requires residual record")
        # A source section may select cross-linked records, but must retain at
        # least one record actually grounded in that section when claiming it.
        if disposition["decision"] in ("retained", "residual"):
            require(any(record["key"] in chosen and any(g["section_id"] == disposition["section_id"] for g in record["grounding"]) for record in records), "retained section has no local grounded record")
        selected.update(chosen)
    require(selected == set(keys), "selection ledger omits authored records")


def emit_proposal(output: Path, plan: dict[str, Any], chunks: list[dict[str, Any]],
                  answers: dict[str, dict[str, Any]], provenance: list[dict[str, str]], *,
                  upstream: Path | None = None,
                  formal_checker: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Shared checked materialization; callers own their actual author evidence."""
    known = {chunk["id"]: chunk for chunk in chunks}
    require(set(answers) <= set(known), "answer for an unknown source chunk")
    for identity, answer in answers.items():
        author_check(answer, known[identity])
    model, coverage = model_from_answers(plan, chunks, answers, provenance)
    model_checked = ac_graph.validate(model)
    carrier = ac_graph.materialize(model_checked)
    require(ac_graph.decode(carrier).document == model, "proposal carrier did not preserve authored model")
    folder = _run_path(output, output / ("partial-proposal" if len(answers) < len(chunks) else "proposal"), write=True)
    require(not folder.exists(), "assembled proposal already exists; preserve immutable result")
    folder.mkdir()
    save(folder / "model.json", model)
    save(folder / "carrier.json", carrier.document)
    save(folder / "coverage.json", coverage)
    upstream_trial = None
    if plan["mode"] in GRAPH_MODES:
        modules = upstream_modules(_upstream_path(output, upstream or Path(plan["upstream"]["root"])))
        graph = modules["build"].build_from_json(ac_graph.extraction(carrier), dedup=False)
        communities = modules["cluster"].cluster(graph)
        require(modules["export"].to_json(graph, communities, str(folder / "graph.json"), force=True, built_at_commit=UPSTREAM_COMMIT), "upstream proposal export refused")
        recovered = ac_graph.decode(ac_graph.GraphCarrier(load(folder / "graph.json")))
        require(recovered.document == model, "actual upstream proposal round trip changed model")
        upstream_trial = {"commit": UPSTREAM_COMMIT, "nodes": graph.number_of_nodes(), "edges": graph.number_of_edges(), "decoded_model_sha256": recovered.sha256}
    result = {"profile": "ac.generation.proposal/1", "status": "proposed" if coverage["processing_complete"] else "partial_proposal",
              "mode": plan["mode"], "model_id": model["id"], "model_sha256": model_checked.sha256, "family_counts": coverage["family_counts"],
              "processing_complete": coverage["processing_complete"], "upstream_trial": upstream_trial,
              "files": {path.name: sha(path.read_bytes()) for path in folder.iterdir() if path.is_file()},
              "claim": "Mechanically valid, source-grounded F_P proposal and lossless carrier; interpretation fidelity and semantic acceptance unassessed."}
    check_formal_proposal(plan, folder, result, formal_checker=formal_checker)
